title: Gamma bounds and a corrected finite derivative calculation

results.domain: Gamma ratio for every real x>0 with its continuous endpoint x=0; original Taylor receiver for all stated positive parameters, integer M>=1, J>=12 and |p|<=1.
results.proved: Sharp gamma-product bounds, strict decrease and strict log-convexity; exact original Taylor cutoff with constants316and632 and corrected equality at m=0.
results.programme_use: Supplies the previously unproved gamma input for the source's finite zeta derivative calculation. This is an available computational bound, not a claim that the programme's arithmetic integral evaluations have already been replaced by a certified implementation.

results.domain: Exact positive H on x>0; finite original derivative list 0<=m<=3L-3, integer L>=1, original positive error data and |p|<=1. Executable selection uses certified convergent rational enclosures, as explicitly specified in the proof.
results.proved: Exact H(2006)<H(2000); finite derivative selection with unchanged minimum error allowance; equality-safe strict tests; rational cutoff and polynomial-evaluation construction; full-index alternative.
results.programme_use: Replaces dependence on the printed global-monotonicity lemma at the source's derivative-output interface, preserving every original tolerance rather than propagating an unsupported source assertion.

limitations: No RH conclusion or global zero theorem.
No certification of the entire Riemann-Siegel implementation.
No proof here of the separate secondinegamma lemma.
PartI derivative/coefficient estimates are attributed through PartII, not claimed independently read.
Finite exact checks do not replace the all-domain analytic proofs.
